1 Signature Not Verified  O R D E R Reason:
The petitioners before this Court are seeking anticipatory bail, which was declined by the High Court by an order dated 04.10.2024.
The petitioners are the accused for the offences punishable under Sections 354, 354B, 323, 506, 376 of the Indian Penal Code and is facing investigation.
Vide order dated 18.11.2024, interim protection was granted to the petitioners, subject to cooperation in the investigation.
Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, we do not think that this is a case where custodial interrogation of the petitioners is required.
But this would not mean that the petitioners will stop cooperating with the ongoing investigation.
The petitioners shall respond to the Investigating Officer and shall visit the Police Station as and when they are required.
However, under the circumstances, we are of the opinion that the petitioners are entitled for anticipatory bail.

In the event of arrest of the petitioners in connection with FIR No. 0007 dated 16.01.2020 registered at Police Station  Mahila Thana, District Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, they shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.
